name: physical-intelligence-lab
description: Camera evidence, world-state forecasts and governed factory and city actions in one readable control room.

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-studio.mjs && node scripts/prepare-city.mjs && next dev
scripts.build: node scripts/prepare-studio.mjs && node scripts/prepare-city.mjs && node --check public/room/studio.js && node --check public/room/facility.js && node --check public/room/perception.js && node --check public/room/vision-worker.js && node --check public/room/city.js && node --check public/room/city-model.js && node --check public/room/city-perception.js && node --check public/room/city-studio.js && node --check public/room/entry.js && next build
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
